Fixes from a full review of the code, a limit that protects the podcast feature on the public site, and
automatic tests.

**Use it now:** [vemsavad.promptagency.se](https://vemsavad.promptagency.se) (Chrome or Edge).

### Fixed
- Choosing another model while a queue runs no longer breaks the running job and the ones after it: the
  new model loads between jobs. Settings changed during a queue (speaker separation, auto-download,
  language) now apply from the next job.
- Podcasts: feeds that aren't UTF-8 show å/ä/ö correctly, and download names keep their dots
  ("Ep. 3 Mr. Smith" no longer becomes "Ep. 3 Mr.txt").
- Double-clicking Record no longer leaves the microphone on.
- The review view stays responsive on long transcripts: word-list suggestions only re-check changed
  lines, and open transcripts no longer redraw while another file transcribes.
- Copy says when the browser won't copy; the "not saved" note goes away once everything is saved.
- Markdown and subtitle exports handle a few odd cases (a line of dashes, `&`, a silent recording).

### On the public site
Podcasts go through the site's own server, which now accepts at most 30 requests a minute from one
IP address, so it can't be misused to break podcasts for everyone. Normal use stays far below that.

### Hosting it yourself
`vem-sa-vad-v1.1.0.zip` below is the built site. The PHP podcast proxy now notices an episode that was
cut off mid-download instead of passing on the first part as the whole. See
[docs/hosting.md](https://github.com/promptagency/vem-sa-vad/blob/main/docs/hosting.md).

### For developers
`npm test` runs tests for the logic that breaks silently (speaker windows and assignment, find & replace,
the word list, exports, ZIP), in CI and before every release. `npm run dev` now serves the podcast proxy
with the hosted proxy's own rules.

Built on [Bjarbys Transcriber](https://github.com/fltman/bjarbys-transcriber) by Anders Bjarby (MIT).
